components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one blue action, e.g. Conferma serie.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; min-height:56px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:var(--color-plate-blue,#2453d6); color:var(--color-luce,#f2f1ec); font:600 17px/1.4 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; transition:transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f2f1ec; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; min-height:56px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:#23262b; color:#f2f1ec; font:600 17px/1.4 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; transition:transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f2f1ec; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Filter chip, inverts to luce when pressed.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:#23262b; color:#f2f1ec; font:600 15px/1.35 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed=true] { background:#f2f1ec; color:#0b0c0e; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f2f1ec; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Text field with a bottom border that lights on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; padding:12px; border:0; border-bottom:1.5px solid transparent; border-radius:6px; background:#23262b; color:#f2f1ec; font:400 17px/1.4 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; outline:none; } .ds-field::placeholder { color:#8f949b; } .ds-field:focus { border-bottom-color:#f2f1ec; }

components.name: Lower third
components.description: Wood tab with the set count and the light name plate.
components.css: .ds-lt { display:flex; align-items:stretch; font-family:Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:0 14px 0 8px; background:#b8875a; color:#0b0c0e; border-radius:2px 0 0 2px; clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,calc(100% - 6px) 100%,0 100%); font-style:italic; font-stretch:62%; font-weight:800; font-size:22px; } .ds-plate { padding:8px 10px; background:#f2f1ec; color:#0b0c0e; font-style:italic; font-stretch:75%; font-weight:800; font-size:26px; line-height:1.1; }

components.name: Judges' lights
components.description: Three lights per set: green when done, outlined while to do.
components.css: .ds-lights { display:flex; gap:4px; } .ds-lights i { width:10px; height:10px; box-sizing:border-box; border-radius:50%; border:1.5px solid rgb(143 148 155 / 0.7); } .ds-lights i.on { background:#2ba55b; border:0; }

components.name: Current set band
components.description: The current set as a blue band with a large stepper value.
components.css: .ds-band { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:12px 16px; background:#2453d6; color:#f2f1ec; } .ds-step { width:56px; height:56px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:#23262b; color:#f2f1ec; font-size:24px; } .ds-val { flex:1; text-align:center; font:italic 800 44px/1 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch:62%; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Timer bar
components.description: Full-width rest clock with a shortening wood wire.
components.css: .ds-timer { position:relative; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; min-height:96px; padding:0 16px; background:#17191d; color:#f2f1ec; font-family:Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-timer .wire { position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:0; height:3px; background:#b8875a; transform-origin:left; transform:scaleX(0.6); } .ds-timer .lbl { font:600 13px/1.3 Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch:87.5%; color:#8f949b; } .ds-timer .clk { font-style:italic; font-stretch:62%; font-weight:800; font-size:72px; line-height:1; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Every set is an attempt on the platform and the rest is the meet clock: the app is the broadcast graphics of a weightlifting competition with one athlete. A dark arena carries the light-coloured numbers, wood marks tabs, the clock wire and references, and the plate colours each keep one meaning. It is built to be read at arm's length under strong gym light and operated with one thumb.

Density is that of a scoreboard: big condensed italic numbers, one-pixel rules, near-square corners, no shadows. The felt moment is the set confirmation: three lights come on, the blue band slides to the next set, the clock starts.

The system rejects the rounded-card fitness dashboard, progress rings and neon accents.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only (color-scheme: dark), arena ground, tribuna panels, luce text.
Numbers in extra-condensed black italic; names in a condensed black italic plate face; text in roman Archivo.
Blue means act / current, green means done, yellow means record, red is destructive (icon only), wood is reference.
Hairlines (0.5px) instead of boxes; flat, no shadow anywhere.
Tap targets 44px minimum, 56px on the workout path.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each plate colour carries one meaning (blue act, green done, yellow record, red destroy). Never use one as decoration.

rules.name: The Wood Is Reference Rule
rules.body: Pedana wood marks labels, the clock wire and reference bands; it is never a button fill.

rules.name: The Tabellone Rule
rules.body: Every number on screen uses the num face: italic, 62% width, 800, tabular figures.

rules.name: The Targa Rule
rules.body: Names and large titles use the plate face: italic, 75% width, 800.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case and never all caps.

rules.name: The 16px Input Rule
rules.body: Inputs are never below 16px (max(16px, 1em)); weights use decimal keyboard, reps numeric.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow in the system. Separation comes from tone and hairlines.

dos: Do set every number in the num face and every name in the plate face.
Do use plate blue for the single current action, green for done, yellow for record.
Do separate with 0.5px filetto hairlines and tone steps (arena, tribuna, fondale).
Do keep taps at 44px and workout-path controls at 56px, inputs at 16px or more.
Do compute everything from the fixed px type scale; add a step only when a new role needs one.
Do reveal graphics with the left-to-right wipe or the 240ms ease-out slide; honour reduced motion.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients or rounded dashboard cards.
Don't use progress rings or a neon accent.
Don't set labels in all caps.
Don't use wood as a button fill or a plate colour for decoration.
Don't use red for text (4.3:1 on arena); use the icon.
Don't put an animation on a transform that must persist (fixed or sticky children).
